feed.title: [BIP Draft] NestedMuSig2: Recursive MuSig2 for BIP340-compatible Signatures

entry.title: [BIP Draft] NestedMuSig2: Recursive MuSig2 for BIP340-compatible Signatures
entry.summary:
NestedMuSig2 introduces a recursive extension to MuSig2, as defined in BIP327, by enabling hierarchical signing groups. Through this approach, each subgroup is able to participate with its aggregate public key, forming a tree structure of signers who can collaboratively generate a single BIP340-compatible signature. This method ensures that the overall signature process does not disclose the internal structure or membership of the signing groups, preserving privacy and flexibility in multi-party signing scenarios.
The draft proposal outlining NestedMuSig2 is available at [BIP draft and reference implementation](https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/pull/2297), with additional context provided in the academic paper [here](https://eprint.iacr.org/2026/223). The specification calls particular attention to several nuanced aspects: the management of nonces in recursive scenarios, the construction of sessions for nested groups, the application of tweaks at the root level, and maintaining compatibility with the existing BIP327 standard.
Feedback is actively sought regarding the technical details of the specification, especially in terms of nonce handling, session design, and integration with previous standards. Furthermore, careful review of the reference implementation and evaluation of associated test vectors are requested to ensure correctness and robustness of the proposed protocol.
